authorship: Agent-authored protocol baseline prepared independently of the compiler and pilot outputs. No human participant study.
policy: If the mailbox accepted delivery, its single SMTP envelope recipient must equal the approved recipient and the multiset of delivered MIME-decoded attachment byte strings must be a submultiset of the granted attachment byte strings. Extra authorized but unused items are allowed. Message body, filenames and order are irrelevant.
envelope_assumptions: Both sources attest to the same attempt ID and snapshot/terminal semantics with separate authenticators. A source record is either present with its data, an explicit trusted negative (no grant or terminal non-delivery), or missing/pending, which is unknown. Null field(s) on an explicit negative are distinct from a witnessed accepted message with an empty attachment list. If the base protocol cannot encode these states, also record status at each source for every configuration.
field_assumptions: Comparable attempt-scoped recipient tags and per-item content tags use separate domains and shared canonicalization at the two trusted writers. Attachment item tags are materialized as a multiset, including multiplicities, calculated over decoded bytes. Treat unobserved fields as unknown. One bag tag supports exact multiset equality, not arbitrary subset queries.

expert_minimal.role: predeclared expert-style manually specified privacy baseline
expert_minimal.rationale: Only cross-source recipient equality and attachment submultiset membership are necessary for the binary policy. No recipient string, message body, filename, size, or literal file bytes are needed. Item tags disclose within-attempt matching and counts.

full_operational.role: illustrative raw baseline for footprint, not an observed deployment or human policy
full_operational.rationale: Keep full mail metadata and content. Compare coverage and footprint with the minimal profile using identical transport and envelope semantics.

metadata_only.rationale: Two distinct equal-length payloads with one filename can have identical metadata.

whole_bag.rationale: Grant [A,B] and deliver [A] is allowed; grant [A,B] and deliver [C] is forbidden. Both have matching recipient, counts 2 and 1, and unequal whole-bag tags.

missing_delivery_attachment.rationale: An approval snapshot does not identify the content actually committed by the mailbox.

missing_delivery_recipient.rationale: A correctly authorized attachment can still have been delivered to the wrong endpoint.
